headline: Earnings swing to a profit, roughly flat year-over-year
summary_short: Hachi-Ban reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥32.34, swinging from a ¥5.31 per-share loss last quarter and roughly flat versus ¥32.51 a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of ¥32.34 swung from a ¥5.31 per-share loss in the prior quarter (+¥37.65 q/q) and was little changed year-over-year versus ¥32.51 (-0.5%). This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
